title: AMH (anti-Müllerian hormone)
what: This is a blood test from a vein. It helps estimate how many eggs are left in your ovaries.
why: When planning a pregnancy, before IVF, for irregular periods, or before ovarian surgery.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come in 2 to 5 days
tell_doctor: If you take birth control pills or other hormones

prepare.title: Cycle day
prepare.text: AMH can usually be tested on any day of your cycle. If your doctor named a day, go on that day.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Best in the morning before eating, or a few hours after a light meal. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: For 24 hours, no alcohol and no hard workouts. Best not to smoke in the morning.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Tell your doctor what you take. They will decide if anything should change.

steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tightened above your elbow
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick, and blood fills a tube
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes and keep your arm straight
You can eat right away and go back to your usual day
Results usually come in 2 to 5 days. The lab will tell you when
Your gynecologist will look at the result together with an ultrasound and other tests

faq.q: Does low AMH mean I cannot get pregnant?
faq.a: No. AMH shows your egg supply, not whether you will get pregnant. Talk it over with your doctor.

faq.q: Which cycle day is best for AMH?
faq.a: Usually any day. If your doctor named a specific day, follow that.

reminders.text: AMH test tomorrow. Best to come before eating. Water is fine.
